messages.text: hey Sarah.   I just redeemed my points from Harlo mining pool for a B30!

Congrats, that's a great way to get one. The B30 does 30 TH/s at about 405 W, and it takes a shot at a full block every ten minutes. What can I help with: setup, pool settings, or something about the redemption?

No real issues in Canada. It runs fine on standard 120 V outlets, it comes with a North American plug, and there's no import VAT or duty. Sales tax, where it applies, gets added at checkout. Want me to work out what it'll cost you in power each month? Just tell me your rate per kWh, or your province.
Yes, I'm an AI, the store's shopping assistant. If you'd ever rather talk to someone on the team, just say so and I'll pass it along. Enjoy the B30, and good luck on the block.
